decisionProcess.summary: Partially accessible at the organizational level but not at the hotel-buyer level. Public evidence shows Dominican government procurement of hotel participation and MIREX/OAS coordination of Summit logistics; it does not disclose the hotel-sourcing owner, TMC, approved-property list, framework agreement or transient-versus-meetings split.
decisionProcess.notes: Treat the named officials as relevant influencers/referrals only. Route the next inquiry through MIREX/Summits Secretariat and DGCP, asking for the responsible logistics/procurement desk and supplier process. Do not send a generic resort pitch to OAS or IDB press/publication contacts.
unknowns: The target is a composite of several institutions, not a single legal buyer.
The specific hotel venue allocation, room block, meeting requirement and catering scope are unknown.
No preferred hotel pattern, TMC, central travel owner or meetings procurement workflow is documented.
No named individual is proven to sign a hotel contract.
No public source reviewed provides a named hotel-sourcing manager, travel manager, meetings buyer or event procurement lead.
The supplied hotel context lacks official address, official property URL, brand and detailed meeting specifications.
The 2026 public-procurement congress is current but may be too late to create forward demand for this property unless repeat activity or follow-on events are identified.
